discarded_probe.reason: Early audit harness declared every by-value char argument as ctypes.c_byte, including unsigned-char C ABIs. That violates ABI sign/zero-extension expectations. These observations are not evidence for or against compiler correctness. Replaced by pointer-based character loads whose pointer ABI is unambiguous.
